This skeletal Mahjarrat is one of the youngest of his race. He doesn't seem to have a guilty conscience about kidnapping rich people to fight in his arena, so he probably won't worry about fighting dirty.

Quest: Fight Arena

Combat: He starts off small and ugly, but when you kill his first version you'll be confronted with a larger, deadlier and, quite possibly, uglier version of the Mahjarrat man. He attacks with melee.
